$comment: Shipped defaults. Do NOT edit this file - your settings live in config.json, which is deep-merged over this and is gitignored. Run `jarvis setup` to create it.
name: J.A.R.V.I.S.
tagline: JUST A RATHER VERY INTELLIGENT SYSTEM

chat.allowed_tools: Read Glob Grep WebSearch WebFetch Write Edit ToolSearch Skill Bash(yt-dlp:*) Bash(python3:*) Bash(ls:*)
chat.$comment_mcp: MCP servers Jarvis may use. Names as shown by `claude mcp list`, or "all". Empty means none, because these tools send email and post publicly. Manage with: jarvis mcp

$comment_documents_dirs: EXTRA folders to show in the documents trail. reports/, drafts/, and journal/ are always included and are found relative to wherever you cloned this, so they do not belong here. Use this for a notes vault or a project folder elsewhere on disk.
$comment_journal: The nightly entry. dir is empty to mean journal/ beside the repo; set it only to keep entries somewhere else. deliver is none, gmail, or resend. none writes the file and stops - the default, because the other two leave your machine. gmail creates a DRAFT you press send on; the Gmail connector cannot send. resend actually sends, and needs RESEND_API_KEY and JARVIS_MAIL_FROM in .env.
$comment_social: Which Apify actor to use per platform. Pinned on purpose: an agent that searches the store every morning can silently pick a different actor with different cost, different output, and different reliability. Change these to swap, and the agent reports a failure rather than substituting.
